label: Article
description: An article, such as a news article or piece of investigative report. Newspapers and magazines have articles of many different types and this is intended to cover them all.\n\nSee also [blog post](https://blog.schema.org/2014/09/02/schema-org-support-for-bibliographic-relationships-and-periodicals/).

fields.label: author
fields.help: The author of this content or rating. Please note that author is special in that HTML 5 provides a special mechanism for indicating authorship via the rel tag. That is equivalent to this and may be used interchangeably.

fields.label: dateModified
fields.help: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

fields.label: datePublished
fields.help: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

fields.label: image
fields.help: An image of the item. This can be a [[URL]] or a fully described [[ImageObject]].

fields.label: inLanguage
fields.help: The language of the content or performance or used in an action. Please use one of the language codes from the [IETF BCP 47 standard](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47). See also [[availableLanguage]].

fields.label: keywords
fields.help: Keywords or tags used to describe some item. Multiple textual entries in a keywords list are typically delimited by commas, or by repeating the property.

fields.label: thumbnailUrl
fields.help: A thumbnail image relevant to the Thing.
